data.action: 白无垢十指相扣立神前，紫瞳认真含泪微笑
data.camera: wide shot, formal portrait, bride holding hands, shrine light, tender vow
data.description: 【神社·婚礼日】向来向死而行的虫柱，今天披上了纯白无垢。白角隐下的紫瞳认真得前所未有，她在神前与你十指相扣——「我这一生的剧毒，本该随我葬进夜里。……但如果是你，毒也会变成药。所以，请让我把余下的每一天，都用来对你温柔。」
data.promptProse: Shinobu Kocho clasps her companion's hand before the shrine altar, violet eyes unusually earnest beneath a white tsunokakushi. Her opaque shiromuku, woven obi and white tabi keep the ceremony composed. The wide formal portrait includes both joined hands, the shrine's wooden columns and floor stretching toward the altar. Gentle morning light beneath the eaves reveals white silk textures and her face, with soft folds and floor shadows defining the seated ceremonial space.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 白无垢的花嫁之誓·「如果是你，毒也会变成药」
